markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (95%)** · Confident · Careful review

Single-class conformal set and 4 of 5 similar cases agree, but the second model does not.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 95%, InSitu 5% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 98th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive [F5] | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; associated with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 8) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical here · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; spot check poor · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 7) · context · Below typical; descriptive only · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical score; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and normal lobules are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is a JPEG-degraded simulated frozen section, and the second model picks a different top class.
- Reliability score ranks errors modestly (AUROC 0.69), so 0.99 does not rule out error.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 6, 9** — confirm tumor cells infiltrating stroma.
2. **Regions 2, 10** — lowest per-region invasive scores (26%, 41%); look for non-invasive tissue.
3. **Region 11** — ducts/lobules concepts are unreliable; confirm, and check low-scoring lateral margin segment.
